messages:
michael: Hey team — quick IAM question. I need to give a contractor access to rotate API keys for project-foo. Thinking of granting Console Admin at project scope. Bad idea? Any recommended least-privilege role combo? Also want to ensure logs don't leak key material.

anya: Don't give Console Admin. That's way too broad for a contractor. Prefer either a custom role or a narrow set: service account key create/update perms + secret access if keys live in Secret Manager.

sam: Concretely — if you store keys in Secret Manager: grant only `secretmanager.versions.access` on the specific secret resource. For service account key rotation you can scope `iam.serviceAccountKeys.create` and `iam.serviceAccountKeys.delete` on the service account. No need for project-wide Console Admin.

jess: Also we should ensure logging/redaction is in place: add a log sink or pattern-based exclusion for raw key material, and prefer structured logs (no free-text dumps). We can run the secrets scanner over recent logs after the change.

michael: That helps. Do we have an existing custom role template I can reuse? I want to create a role like `roles/projectKeyRotator` with a TTL.

anya: We have a snippet you can copy:
```
permissions:
  - secretmanager.versions.access
  - iam.serviceAccountKeys.create
  - iam.serviceAccountKeys.delete
  - iam.serviceAccounts.get
```
Scope it to `projects/project-foo/serviceAccounts/sa-rotator@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and mark the binding with a condition for `request.time` (time-bound).

security-bot: Reminder: External contractor access requires an Access Approval + SSO enforced. Request created: https://console.example.com/approvals/REQ-8472

sam: :thumbsup: Add 2FA enforcement and set the binding to expire (time-limited). If they need Console UI, use the least-privileged predefined roles like `roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor` instead of Console Admin.

jess: I'll create a follow-up ticket to add a log-redaction task to infra backlog. michael — ping me after you open the PR and I'll review the policy and the secrets-scan.

michael: Opening PR now with the custom role and time-bound binding. Thanks all :pray:
